installationPage.title: Installation & Architecture
installationPage.description: How to integrate Krokbit Labs WebGL and UI primitives into your Next.js App Router project.
installationPage.step1Desc: All UI primitives rely on Tailwind CSS utility classes and hardware-accelerated backdrop filters.
installationPage.step2Desc: For 3D components (Wavy Sphere, Particles Grid), install Three.js and React Three Fiber:
installationPage.step3Desc: Open any component, switch to the Code tab, copy the source into src/components/, and import it. Zero hidden black-box wrappers.

cliPage.title: Krokbit CLI
cliPage.description: Automated terminal scaffolder for injecting components directly into your source tree.
cliPage.roadmapDesc: The @krokbit/labs CLI reads your tsconfig.json paths and downloads raw TypeScript/GLSL source files directly into your repository. While registry publishing is being finalized, use the manual Copy Code button on each component page.
